title: factory board config
description: Every value loop.sh needs that is not a record. Setting the board up on another repo is editing this file (RUNBOOK.md). poll_seconds is what the open page waits between asks for data.json; watch_seconds is what the watch pane waits between collects. A record is drawn within poll_seconds + watch_seconds, so the two must sum to 30 or less (AC-H3 of WO-20261011-616c); loop.sh checks that, a schema cannot. Paths are relative to the repository root.

out_dir.description: where index.html and data.json are written; gitignored state

actor.description: who the page says built it

events_dir.description: the event log: YYYY/MM/<name>.json. ${tree:records} is the state root's records tree (bin/state-root.sh), where events/bin/event.sh writes; a relative path is read under the repository root, the old reading

events_days.description: records older than this many days are not read; a line's records are days old, never months

work_orders_dir.description: ticket files WO-*.md with a JSON frontmatter, read in every subdirectory

herdr_config.description: carries .session and .workspace_label, the herdr workspace whose panes are listed

runner_config.description: the route runner's config, with ${repo} the checkout; its state_dir plus /belt is the belt file route.sh touches, and the belt runs while that file's age is within belt_max_age_seconds

owner_pane_label.description: a pane whose label contains this means the owner's page server is up

line_statuses.description: a ticket in one of these statuses is a line on the floor

role.description: a roles/<role>.json name; null for a station with no seat (the owner)

model.description: overrides the role file's model and effort

takes.description: route fields this station is the target of, when its role has several stations (the architect checks main after a merge: with verify)

route.description: the row of the routes table this lane draws; its tag is derived from that row, and a lane naming no row is refused

board.description: the tickets the build board tracks, in order; the bar of each is derived from its status
